meta.description: Learn about our company story, mission, vision, and the team behind Aspak Global.

hero.label: Our Story
hero.heading:
A Company Built for the
Modern Thai Economy
hero.body: Aspak Global was founded to bridge the gap between Thailand's dynamic market and the world — delivering integrated services that empower businesses to grow, compete, and thrive.

mission.label: Mission & Vision
mission.missionBody: To connect businesses with the solutions they need — through technology, trade, and service — creating measurable value at every step.
mission.visionBody: To be the most trusted and versatile integrated services company in Southeast Asia, recognized for integrity, innovation, and impact.

items.title: Integrity
items.description: We conduct every engagement with transparency and accountability.

items.title: Excellence
items.description: We set high standards and pursue them relentlessly in every service we deliver.

items.title: Partnership
items.description: We succeed when our clients succeed — long-term relationships are our foundation.

items.title: Innovation
items.description: We continuously look for smarter, more efficient ways to serve our clients.

director.name: Ms. Pitchayapak Kaewsart
director.title: Director
director.bio: Ms. Pitchayapak Kaewsart leads Aspak Global with a focus on sustainable growth, client partnerships, and operational excellence across all five business divisions.

items.title: Company Founded
items.description: Aspak Global Co., Ltd. was established in Bangkok with a vision to deliver integrated trading and services solutions.

items.title: IT Division Launched
items.description: Expanded into IT Solutions, offering software development, network infrastructure, and consulting services to Thai businesses.

items.title: Import & Export Operations
items.description: Established international trade channels, connecting Thai businesses with suppliers and buyers across 20+ countries.

items.title: Packaging & Office Supply
items.description: Added Packaging & Paper and Office Supply divisions, providing comprehensive B2B product solutions to corporate clients.

items.title: Dee Cleaning Company
items.description: Launched Dee Cleaning Company, bringing professional cleaning services to offices, hotels, hospitals, and residences across Bangkok.

items.title: Growth & Expansion
items.description: Continued expansion of our client portfolio and service capabilities, cementing our position as a trusted multi-service partner.

meta.title: IT Solutions — Aspak Global Co., Ltd.
meta.description: End-to-end IT services including software development, cloud infrastructure, cybersecurity, and IT consulting in Bangkok.

hero.label: IT Solutions
hero.heading:
Technology That
Moves Your Business Forward
hero.body: We deliver end-to-end IT services tailored to the needs of Thai businesses — from custom software development and cloud migration to cybersecurity and ongoing IT support.

items.title: Software Development
items.description: Custom web and mobile applications built to solve your specific business challenges, using modern frameworks and agile delivery.

items.title: Network & Infrastructure
items.description: Design, installation, and management of enterprise networks — LAN, WAN, wireless, and secure VPN configurations.

items.title: Cloud Services
items.description: Cloud migration, architecture design, and managed cloud operations across AWS, Azure, and Google Cloud platforms.

items.title: Cybersecurity
items.description: Vulnerability assessments, security audits, firewall configuration, and employee security awareness training.

items.title: IT Consulting
items.description: Strategic technology planning, digital transformation roadmaps, and vendor-neutral advice for your IT investments.

items.title: IT Maintenance & Support
items.description: Proactive monitoring, helpdesk support, and scheduled maintenance to keep your systems running at peak performance.

meta.title: Import & Export — Aspak Global Co., Ltd.
meta.description: International trade facilitation, sourcing, distribution, and agency services from Bangkok to the world.

hero.label: Import & Export
hero.heading:
Thailand to the World —
The World to Thailand
hero.body: We facilitate seamless cross-border trade, connecting Thai businesses with global suppliers and opening international markets for Thai products.

items.title: Consumer Goods Trade
items.description: Sourcing and trading of fast-moving consumer goods across international markets with competitive pricing and reliable supply chains.

items.title: Sourcing & Procurement
items.description: Identifying, vetting, and managing suppliers across Asia, Europe, and beyond — so you get the best value for every purchase.

items.title: Distribution Management
items.description: Efficient last-mile and regional distribution networks that get your products where they need to be, on time.

items.title: Agency & Brokerage
items.description: Representing foreign brands in Thailand and Thai products abroad — acting as your trusted local or regional agent.

items.title: Trade Documentation
items.description: Complete handling of import/export documentation, customs compliance, and regulatory requirements.

items.title: Logistics Coordination
items.description: Freight forwarding, shipping coordination, and logistics optimization for sea, air, and land cargo.

reach.heading: Our Trade Reach
reach.body: With active trading relationships spanning over 20 countries, Aspak Global opens doors across Asia, Europe, and beyond.

items.title: Kraft Paper Products

items.title: Plastic Packaging

items.description: Branded packaging with custom printing, embossing, and finishing options to make your products stand out.

Everything Your

items.title: Office Equipment

meta.title: Dee Cleaning Company — Aspak Global Co., Ltd.
meta.description: Professional cleaning services for offices, factories, hotels, hospitals, and residences across Bangkok.

hero.label: Cleaning Services
hero.heading:
Professional Cleaning
You Can Trust
hero.body: Dee Cleaning Company delivers reliable, professional cleaning services across Bangkok — from daily office maintenance to deep cleaning, post-construction, and hospital-grade disinfection.

items.title: Office Cleaning
items.description: Daily, weekly, and periodic deep cleaning for offices of all sizes — keeping your workplace pristine and professional.

items.title: Factory & Warehouse
items.description: Industrial cleaning services for manufacturing plants, warehouses, and logistics facilities, complying with safety standards.

items.title: Hotel & Hospitality
items.description: Room turnover, common area maintenance, and housekeeping services tailored to hospitality standards.

items.title: Hospital & Medical
items.description: Sterile-environment cleaning with hospital-grade disinfectants and strict infection control protocols.

items.title: Residential & Condo
items.description: Move-in/move-out cleaning, regular housekeeping, and deep cleaning for homes and condominium units.

items.title: Post-Construction
items.description: Complete post-construction clean-up removing debris, dust, and residues to prepare your space for occupancy.

items.title: Disinfection Services
items.description: Certified disinfection using EPA-approved solutions — suitable for COVID-19, influenza, and general pathogen control.

items.title: Event Cleaning
items.description: Before-and-after event cleaning for conferences, exhibitions, and corporate functions.
